name: nlinfit
expr: [beta, R, J, CovB, MSE] = nlinfit(x, y, fun, [1.0; 1.0]); ci = nlparci(beta, R, J); [yp, d] = nlpredci(fun, x(1:5), beta, R, J, 0.05); err_a = abs(beta(1) - 2.0); err_b = abs(beta(2) - 0.5); ci_contains_a = double(ci(1,1) <= 2.0 && 2.0 <= ci(1,2)); ci_contains_b = double(ci(2,1) <= 0.5 && 0.5 <= ci(2,2)); pos_delta = double(all(d > 0));
comment: Sig: nlinfit(X, y, fun, beta0) — Levenberg-Marquardt NLS with numerical (central-diff) Jacobian. Returns [beta, R, J, CovB, MSE]. nlparci(beta, R, J [, alpha]) — Wald-style parameter CIs via t-quantile · sqrt(diag(MSE · (J'J)^-1)). nlpredci(fun, X, beta, R, J [, alpha]) — prediction CIs via delta-method on the per-query Jacobian. KNOWN GAPs: name-value 'Weights'/'ErrorModel'/'Options' not supported. Spec uses deterministic noise (sin-based) to make parity reproducible; pins recoverability + CI containment + shape invariants.
